description: Ministry of Lands - The Land Acquisitions (Payment of Compensation) Regulations 2013
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves amendments to regulations under the Land Acquisition Act. It focuses on legal/regulatory matters - specifically modifying compensation payment regulations and adding new infrastructure projects to the list of those covered. While it mentions the Minister of Lands, it does not contain detailed portfolio responsibilities or personnel changes, and the core content is about legal regulatory amendments rather than government structure or personnel matters.
